ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the picture is a food web, with “Meadow Grasses” labeled at the bottom, and arrows from Meadow Grasses pointing to Deer, Rabbit, Vole; these animals then point through arrows to predators such as Coyote and Hawk. Then reason: producers are usually plants that can make their own food, and are located at the base position of the food web. The one located at the bottom in the picture and that is a plant is Meadow Grasses, so the producer is meadow grasses.
